# TheHeroes Agency · Author Studio

> A design studio run by Mou Barrac that builds author websites, book launch funnels and email marketing for nonfiction authors. Projects take 2 to 4 weeks.

## Key pages
- [Services](https://theheroesagency.org/services): what the studio builds for nonfiction authors
- [Pricing](https://theheroesagency.org/pricing): packages, add-ons and payment terms
- [Work](https://theheroesagency.org/work): author website showcases
- [About](https://theheroesagency.org/about): Mou Barrac and how the studio works
- [Contact](https://theheroesagency.org/contact): email info@theheroesagency.org or book a 15-minute call
- [Blog](https://theheroesagency.org/blog): guides on author websites and email marketing
